name: sketchpad-basic
description: Sketchpad Basic helps creators communicate ideas to ChatGPT with drawings, notes, images, and clear visual emphasis.

interface.shortDescription: Show ChatGPT what you mean with a simple sketch.
interface.longDescription: Sketchpad Basic helps creators communicate visual ideas through a simple canvas with drawing tools, colors, text, camera and image placement, zoom and pan, separate guidance notes, and a one-click ChatGPT handoff.
interface.defaultPrompt: Interpret this Sketchpad Basic drawing and notes together. Treat the sketch as a rough concept, use any camera photo as visual reference, follow the creator's Rules, and summarize the creator's intent.
